measurementProtocol.officialSource: Owner-authenticated Naver Search Advisor contents impressions/clicks (Web Search only) and separately URL inspection. The owner report was updated 2026-11-16; not a live ChatGPT reading.
measurementProtocol.compare: Compare equal periods/devices and underlying non-overlapping date windows where knowable. Naver reports with a roughly one-week publication lag; recent rolling 30-day windows overlap and cannot prove causal effects. Refuse to imply a CTR gain from code-only audit.
measurementProtocol.priority: Obtain owner official report on the new updated date with overall + URL top table + query top table; separately inspect Gangneung daeri. URL-by-query/average ranking may be unavailable. Exports/screenshots from authenticated owner where possible; no unauthorized access.
measurementProtocol.cannotConclude: 1.6% CTR is not a ranking or conversion diagnosis; impressions without clicks can reflect position, snippet intent, audience, or limited traffic; no claim about causality.
